entries.0300eefeb3453f69: The business builds and sells homes overseas and develops towns and buildings. It sells for-sale housing and undertakes construction of detached houses in the United States and Australia, provides design through manufacturing, delivery and installation of framing members (trusses and panels) for detached and multi-unit housing, develops multi-unit housing and commercial complexes, and undertakes medium- and large-scale construction work in Japan. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,409,803 million (¥1,238,859 million in the previous year), the largest of the four reportable segments and more than half of consolidated revenue of ¥2,267,577 million. Revenue including intersegment internal revenue increased 13.8% from the previous year. Its major affiliates are the Henley group, Metricon group and Scott Park group in Australia, and the Bloomfield Homes, Crescent Communities, DRB, Edge Homes, FLT, MainVue Homes and Mark III Properties, LLC, and JPI groups in the United States. Of these, the DRB group (DRB Enterprises, LLC and 35 other companies) has revenue of ¥436,627 million (excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies), which exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue.
entries.0c6cfde5fb09ada7: Fully Integrated Turnkey Provider Business (FITP Business)
entries.0f21c87c2bda1ee9: Contracting of civil engineering and construction work
entries.150405c7f3901664: Operation of paid nursing homes and serviced housing for older people
entries.19ffa84ce4cf652a: The business builds and sells houses in Japan and continues to look after them after construction. It undertakes construction contracts for detached and multi-unit housing, after-sales maintenance, renovation, sale of for-sale housing, real estate development, leasing, management, sales and brokerage, exterior and landscaping contracting for housing, urban greening, and CAD and site surveys. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥584,644 million (¥541,803 million in the previous year), the second largest business among the reportable segments. Revenue including intersegment internal revenue increased 7.9% from the previous year. Its major affiliates are Sumitomo Forestry Architecno Co., Ltd., Sumitomo Forestry Home Engineering Co., Ltd., Sumitomo Forestry Home Service Co., Ltd., Sumitomo Forestry Home Tech Co., Ltd., Sumitomo Forestry Greening Co., Ltd., Sumitomo Forestry Residential Co., Ltd. and LeTech Co., Ltd.
entries.1c06da18d7dfc460: This field provides an integrated service from design, manufacturing and delivery to installation of the trusses and panels used for house frames, and is working to streamline its production system. Revenue rose on factors including the opening of new factories, but starts of detached and multi-unit housing slumped, and performance was sluggish in the fiscal year ended December 2025.
entries.1d47424dbeccf324: This is the field of managing overseas tree plantations and similar operations. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, performance was sluggish, reflecting wind-throw damage from heavy rain and storms in New Zealand and lower sales volumes and selling prices in the plantation business in Papua New Guinea. To revitalize domestic forestry, the company has begun acquiring logged-over land through a joint venture with Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited and promoting reforestation. Alongside forest regeneration through reforestation, the company aims for a business model that generates profit from the creation of carbon credits with high public value and from timber production.
entries.1de1fe53aae892ad: This field builds detached houses in Australia. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, the business environment improved on factors including lower policy interest rates, and the housing market in Western Australia was strong; in addition, consolidation of the Metricon group, Australia's largest homebuilder in which it acquired an equity stake in November 2024, also contributed, and performance remained firm.
entries.2953c7e1cd1d9d8d: This is a business not included in the reportable segments.
entries.29c4f6db96a828c2: Condominium and detached housing sales business
entries.35bcdd0863475079: Building materials (plywood, fiberboard, wood-based processed building materials, ceramic building materials, metal building materials, housing equipment and other products)
entries.370013eab8fd56aa: A company that, built on forestry management, engages in the construction and sale of housing, real estate development, and the handling of timber and building materials in Japan and overseas.
entries.3e68fd3fdce3c767: This field builds and sells detached houses in the United States. It operates in Texas, Maryland, Utah, Washington and other states. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, mortgage interest rates remained at high levels and the economic outlook was hard to read, and homebuyers continued to hold off, so unit sales declined and performance was sluggish.
entries.416d00e3199b7567: Development of Multi-Unit Housing and Commercial Complexes
entries.486799428a9ec9f1: This is the field of contracting for housing renovation. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, orders for environmentally conscious renovations, such as those that improve insulation performance, progressed, and the company also worked to tap demand from owners of "Sumitomo Forestry Houses", so performance remained firm.
entries.4b3daba76c87f0bc: This is the field of building rental housing and similar properties. Orders for "The Forest Barque", a commercial building brand that promotes wooden construction and wood-based finishing for offices, medical facilities and other buildings, were firm, and average selling prices of rental housing products also rose, so performance in the fiscal year ended December 2025 remained firm. In May 2025, the company made LeTech Co., Ltd., which handles rental condominiums under the "LEGALAND" brand mainly in Tokyo and Osaka, from land acquisition through development, leasing and sale, a subsidiary, and is working to expand the rental housing business.
entries.4c6dd554226a9064: This is the field of woody biomass power generation, which uses wood as fuel. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, woody biomass power plants operated stably, but wood fuel prices remained at high levels, so performance stalled.
entries.54b8909a2eed6876: Domestic Medium- and Large-Scale Wooden Construction
entries.5ae16f363a2e73f4: Business not included in reportable segments This business covers the operation of paid nursing homes and serviced housing for older people, an insurance agency business for housing customers and others, and various services such as contracting of civil engineering and construction work. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥15,685 million (¥15,257 million in the previous fiscal year). Revenue including internal revenue between segments was up 2.9% year on year. Major affiliated companies are Sumirin Enterprise Co., Ltd., Sumirin Carelife Co., Ltd. and Kumagai Gumi Co., Ltd. Kumagai Gumi Co., Ltd. is an equity-method affiliate in which the company holds 21.9% of the voting rights (as of December 31, 2025), and the filing lists collaboration in construction and real estate businesses as a business relationship.
entries.677a8b23d1255e5a: This is the field of selling built houses together with the land. The company put effort into sales promotion, including starting the "Residence Sales Project" to meet demand for high-quality detached houses for sale in central Tokyo, but unit sales fell in the fiscal year ended December 2025 and performance stalled.
entries.71d37ee439a32dd1: This is the field of building detached houses to customer orders. We worked to convey value suited to customer needs, including the semi-order product "Forest Selection BF", which lets customers choose from 1,500 floor plans, and the "Residence Design Project", which draws on our design and proposal capabilities. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, unit sales and average selling prices both rose on the back of strong orders in previous fiscal years, and performance remained firm.
entries.8af8d40befa8f728: This field develops multi-unit housing and commercial complexes in the United States. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, the U.S. real estate market was stagnant, so it partly postponed the sale of multi-unit housing and commercial complexes that had been planned for the year, and performance was sluggish. In September 2025, in cooperation with Kumagai Gumi Co., Ltd., Fuyo General Lease Co., Ltd. and a major local developer, it started construction of rental multi-unit housing combining wood construction with partial reinforced concrete construction near Seattle, Washington State, in the United States.
entries.8b35dbc2c22aef21: Detached Housing in the United States
entries.8b78318241272f4f: This field builds medium- and large-scale buildings, such as offices and student dormitories, in wood in Japan. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, a university student dormitory in Setagaya Ward, Tokyo was completed, and in March 2025 construction began on a wooden office building in Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo through a joint venture with Kumagai Gumi Co., Ltd., advancing wooden construction and the use of wood in the medium- and large-scale building field.
entries.8df7dad12aa9f099: This business deals in forests and renewable energy, and consists of the renewable energy business and the forest resources business. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥24,809 million (¥25,619 million in the previous fiscal year), making it the smallest of the four reportable segments. Revenue including internal revenue between segments was down 0.7% year on year. Major affiliated companies are Monbetsu Biomass Power Co., Ltd. and Tasman Pine Forests Ltd.
entries.a4f20beb173438dd: This business procures, processes and sells wood and building materials. It reflects the company's origins in forest management. It handles wood (logs, chips, sawn lumber, laminated lumber and other wood products) and building materials (plywood, fiberboard, wood-based processed building materials, ceramic building materials, metal building materials, housing equipment and other products). Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥232,043 million (¥231,519 million in the previous fiscal year). Revenue including internal revenue between segments was down 0.1% year on year, roughly flat. Major affiliated companies are Iketo Fuji Co., Ltd., Sumitomo Forestry Crest Co., Ltd., Sumitomo Forestry Forest Service Co., Ltd., PT. Kutai Timber Indonesia and Nelson Pine Industries Ltd.
entries.b37ec477df4f96a9: Development, leasing, management, sale and brokerage of real estate
entries.b7f0650d730616ca: Wood (logs, chips, sawn lumber, laminated lumber and other wood products)
entries.ba487998958a0fd5: This is the field of manufacturing building materials and similar products. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, in Japan, orders and sales in the housing business were firm and sales of interior building materials increased, but soaring raw material prices and other factors meant performance stalled. Overseas, sales volume fell in the plywood business in Indonesia and selling prices fell in the particleboard business in Vietnam, so performance also stalled. In July 2025, the company made a U.S. sawmill company in Louisiana a subsidiary, and it aims to create synergies by supplying sawn lumber to the group's housing businesses in the United States.
entries.da5036f86edd63de: Domestic Medium- and Large-Scale Construction Contracting
entries.dae52342db489025: Contracting of exterior and landscaping work for housing
entries.dd1593cb9b8a138a: Design, Manufacturing, Delivery and Installation of Trusses and Panels
entries.e1f6177f15f133dd: Detached Housing Business in the United States
entries.e2ba37404ed7be3e: This is the field of procuring and selling wood and building materials. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales of wood fuel used in biomass power generation increased in volume, but the number of newly built housing starts in Japan fell, so sales of wood and building materials remained difficult and performance stalled. In August 2025, the company signed a capital and business alliance agreement with GeoLive Group Co., Ltd., which operates building materials distribution, and is aiming to build a unique supply chain combining the functions and know-how of both companies.
entries.eb8438d797d6dd45: Domestic Medium- and Large-Scale Wooden Construction Business
entries.f6a3f75823c1a710: Construction Contracting for Detached and Multi-Unit Housing
